preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in input are within the valid range [1, n], where n is the first integer of each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(len(p) == n for p in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Each permutation p has exactly n elements, where n is the first integer of the corresponding test case.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(p)) == n for p in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Each permutation p contains all distinct integers from 1 to n.
The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2*10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2] if line.isdigit()])

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one integer per test case, matching the number of test cases t.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output) <= n*(n-1)//2 for output, n in zip(stdout.split(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2] if line.isdigit()]))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a non-negative number of operations, bounded by the maximum possible swaps (n*(n-1)//2).

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(p[i] < p[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) if (i, j) != (k, k+1)) and sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) if p[i] > p[j]) == 1 for p in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]) for output, line in zip(stdout.split(), stdin.splitlines()[1::2]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer is the minimum number of swaps needed to transform the permutation into one with exactly one inversion. The inversion must be a single pair (k, k+1) where p[k] > p[k+1], and all other pairs must not be inversions.
